description: Detailed drawings of the new windows and roof lights including key junctions with existing or adjoining fabric and details of open ability, new doors, including key junctions with existing or adjoining fabric, railings,  including key junctions with existing or adjoining fabric,detailed  study of the 'laundry' with detailed drawings of proposals,  including key junctions with existing or adjoining fabric and proposed openings, conservation strategy and restoration/conservation details for the chapel including method statements and reports, in consultation with the Victorian Society, floor build ups  including key junctions with existing or adjoining fabric and threshold junctions, coordinated and accurately detailed services and distribution  including key junctions with existing or adjoining fabric pursuant to condition 6 (1-7) of listed building dated 10th November 2025 (RN: 25/03052/LBC)
